title: T1591.001 — Gather Victim Org Information - Determine Physical Locations
subtitle: The animation above walks through one realistic story: an attacker maps a company’s sites using only public data, then hands the map to the next phase of the operation.
aria: Animated diagram of the attack story step by step. A written version of every step follows below this animation.

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Search public records
steps.caption: The attacker starts with registries, news, and map services to list the sites.
steps.defender: This step leaves almost no trace at the victim.

fields.detail: The attacker starts with registries, news, and map services to list the sites.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Study imagery of HQ and plants
steps.caption: Entrances, docks, fences, and parking are studied in public imagery.
steps.defender: You cannot see this. Awareness training and imagery review are your defenses.

fields.detail: Entrances, docks, fences, and parking are studied in public imagery.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Collect site facts from press
steps.caption: Press releases and job ads confirm addresses and expansion plans.
steps.defender: Fast repeated reads of news pages show up in CDN logs.

fields.detail: Press releases and job ads confirm addresses and expansion plans.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Harvest geotagged photos
steps.caption: The attacker downloads press photos and reads their GPS EXIF data.
steps.defender: Bulk media downloads are visible. Scrubbing EXIF removes the risk.

fields.detail: The attacker downloads press photos and reads their GPS EXIF data.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Note doors, docks, and guards
steps.caption: The attacker turns images into notes about entrances, checkpoints, and quiet hours.
steps.defender: Nothing reaches you at this step. The site profile now lives outside your network.

fields.detail: The attacker turns images into notes about entrances, checkpoints, and quiet hours.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Test site-name look-alike domains
steps.caption: A look-alike domain using a site name is registered for later lures.
steps.defender: Brand and CT monitoring can reveal the new domain early.

fields.detail: A look-alike domain using a site name is registered for later lures.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Plan the approach
steps.caption: The attacker links sites, timings, and pretexts into one physical plan.
steps.defender: Watch for site-themed lures in mail gateway logs and staff reports.

fields.detail: The attacker links sites, timings, and pretexts into one physical plan.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: Hand-off to the operation
steps.caption: The physical map is ready. Follow-on phases can be intrusion or targeted phishing.
steps.defender: From here your network detections take over. Report what you have and connect the pieces.

fields.detail: The physical map is ready. Follow-on phases can be intrusion or targeted phishing.

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
